yew.definition: A species of coniferous tree, Taxus baccata, with dark-green flat needle-like leaves and seeds bearing red arils, native to western, central and southern Europe, northwest Africa, northern Iran and southwest Asia.

yielded.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielding.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yoga.definition: Any of several Hindu or Buddhist disciplines aimed at training the consciousness for a state of perfect spiritual insight and tranquillity; especially a system of exercises practiced to promote control of the body and mind.

yogis.definition: A devotee or adherent of yoga.

york.definition: To bowl a yorker at a batsman, especially to get a batsman out in this way.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

younger.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zany.definition: Unusual and awkward in a funny, comical manner; outlandish; clownish.

zero.definition: The numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero.

zigzagged.definition: A line or path that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

zigzagging.definition: A line or path that proceeds by sharp turns in alternating directions.

zinnias.definition: Any of several brightly coloured flowering plants, of the genus Zinnia, native to tropical America; old maid.

zoo.definition: A park where live animals are exhibited.

zoologist.definition: One who studies or practices zoology.

zoology.definition: The part of biology relating to the animal kingdom, including the structure, embryology, evolution, classification, habits, and distribution of all animals, both living and extinct.
